title: Minimal State Requirement and Computational Complexity Analysis

architecture_constraints.packet_history_storage: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (violates IoT edge memory budget)

Family_A.limitation: Without bounded horizon, integer register will overflow on long-running deployments unless wrapped or clamped

Family_C.limitation: None from a computational standpoint; ideal for edge microcontrollers (e.g. ARM Cortex-M)

Family_D.limitation: Requires maintaining a monotonically increasing clock or step counter t

Family_E.minimal_state_exact: Ring buffer of W entries (bits or floats) + 1 pointer + 1 running sum = O(W) storage
Family_E.memory_bytes_exact: At least W/8 bytes (packed bits) or 4*W bytes (floats). For W=100: 100-400 bytes.
Family_E.complexity_time_exact: O(1) per step via circular ring buffer
Family_E.failure_reason: Exact sliding window violates the O(1) state requirement by requiring history storage proportional to window length W. The EMA approximation reduces to Family B, which is evaluated separately.
